title: My room sentences
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 2 (Pupil PDF worksheet: my room sentences)
intro: Lesson 2: Items in the home and where they are. To understand how to name items in the home and say where they are with prepositions

questions.q: Say: the prayer mat is in the cupboard.
questions.model: Teacher: thing first, السَّجَّادَةُ; then فِي; then الخِزَانَةِ with kasrah.

questions.q: My room in four sentences in the portal response box: what is in it and where each item is; join with وَ. Group B adds an adjective to each item. Start: فِي غُرْفَتِي ...
questions.a: Four correct sentences with items, prepositions and kasrah
questions.model: Teacher writes: فِي غُرْفَتِي سَرِيرٌ وَمَكْتَبٌ. السَّرِيرُ بِجَانِبِ النَّافِذَةِ.

questions.q: say where you keep your mushaf and why.
questions.a: For example: المُصْحَفُ عَلَى الرَّفِّ العَالِي لِأَنَّهُ كَلَامُ اللّٰهِ

questions.q: Back to our ponder: why does where things are kept matter?
questions.a: Order and cleanliness; Allah loves beauty
